address_quote: Element Eatery 5350 Medpace Way Cincinnati, OH 45227

facts.claim: The venue lists free garage and surface parking. Designated accessible spaces, drop-off points and the route from each lot to a door are not specified here.
facts.quote: Free garage and surface parking lots are available to all—refer to the map below for all parking options.

facts.claim: The FAQ describes open seating without reservations and directs group reservations to Catering and Private Events. Neither confirms a particular table or wheelchair space.
quote: Element Eatery offers plenty of open seating, no reservations needed.
To book reservations for groups of any size, start at our Catering and Private Events page.

facts.claim: The FAQ says many vendors offer plant-based and gluten-friendly choices. Check each vendor’s menu and discuss dietary needs directly; gluten-friendly does not establish allergen-free preparation.
facts.quote: Many vendors offer plant-based and gluten-friendly choices. Check individual menus for details.

facts.claim: The venue lists Thanksgiving, Christmas Day and New Year’s Day closures and possible special-event closures. Confirm service for your date.
facts.quote: Thanksgiving, Christmas Day, New Year’s Day. May be closed for special events.

facts.claim: Online carryout ordering is available from vendors. This describes pickup, not a verified curbside collection point or carrying assistance.
facts.quote: Yes! Order online for quick and easy pickup from your favorite vendors.

facts.claim: The venue holds live music, trivia and other events. Check the event calendar when planning around sound or crowding; no quiet period is established.
facts.quote: Stay updated on live music, trivia nights, and more by checking our Events Calendar or following us on social media!

facts.claim: Separate sections of the About page show different café schedules and drink opening times. Confirm the hours for the service you need rather than relying on one section.

facts.claim: The menu is displayed on the classroom’s original blackboard, and food is served family style using a large table-top lazy Susan. Ask about menu-reading or serving arrangements you need.
